findings.quote: Reducing the number of lanes on Burnhamthorpe Road would result in significantly more congestion, delays and vehicle queuing and may, in turn, divert motorists to adjoining local roadways, which are not designed to accommodate this traffic.

This would make the eastbound Lake Shore a viable option for people coming into the City and create the opportunity to divert a significant amount of traffic off of the Gardiner and away from the construction area by leveraging underutilized capacity on Lake Shore Blvd.
